mapper.select: SELECT area_id, COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_id) as current_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN entry_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR) THEN 1 END) as hourly_entry, COUNT(CASE WHEN exit_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR) THEN 1 END) as hourly_exit FROM t_visitor_record WHERE area_id = #{areaId} AND entry_time <= NOW() AND (exit_time IS NULL OR exit_time > NOW()) AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY area_id

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(entry_time, #{interval}) as time_point, COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_id) as visitor_count, AVG(stay_duration) as avg_stay_duration FROM t_visitor_record WHERE area_id = #{areaId} AND entry_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(entry_time, #{interval}) ORDER BY time_point

SELECT area_id, COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_id) as total_visitors, AVG(stay_duration) as avg_stay_duration, MAX( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_id) FROM t_visitor_record v2 WHERE v2.area_id = v1.area_id AND v2.entry_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(entry_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ) as peak_daily_visitors FROM t_visitor_record v1 WHERE area_id = #{areaId} AND entry_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY area_id

SELECT area_id, sub_area_id, COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_id) as current_count, capacity as max_capacity, (COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_id) / capacity * 100) as occupancy_rate FROM t_visitor_record vr JOIN t_area_info ai ON vr.sub_area_id = ai.area_id WHERE vr.area_id = #{areaId} AND vr.entry_time <= NOW() AND (vr.exit_time IS NULL OR vr.exit_time > NOW()) AND vr.deleted = 0 GROUP BY area_id, sub_area_id, capacity

SELECT source_city, COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_id) as visitor_count, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_id) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_id)) OVER(), 2) as percentage FROM t_visitor_record WHERE area_id = #{areaId} AND entry_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY source_city ORDER BY visitor_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT CASE WHEN age < 18 THEN '未成年' WHEN age BETWEEN 18 AND 25 THEN '18-25岁' WHEN age BETWEEN 26 AND 35 THEN '26-35岁' WHEN age BETWEEN 36 AND 50 THEN '36-50岁' WHEN age BETWEEN 51 AND 65 THEN '51-65岁' ELSE '65岁以上' END as age_group, COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_id) as visitor_count, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_id) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_id)) OVER(), 2) as percentage FROM t_visitor_record WHERE area_id = #{areaId} AND entry_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY age_group ORDER BY CASE age_group WHEN '未成年' THEN 1 WHEN '18-25岁' THEN 2 WHEN '26-35岁' THEN 3 WHEN '36-50岁' THEN 4 WHEN '51-65岁' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END
